artifact.source: AW source projection with one ordinary Agent

method: Register the same projected package with real Pi install and Pi install --local, then confirm the exact entry using Pi list.
Read each installed role through the corresponding published extension's discovery implementation in an isolated Pi home and workspace.
For the Nico comparison, change only the temporary source spelling to ./aw-packages/aw-verification-review and restore the original settings after discovery.
For the Tintin comparison, disable package agents in memory and confirm the installed role is no longer discovered.
scopeOfEvidence: Local native registration, role discovery and the named comparison cases. Full sessions, model calls, role execution and other host or extension versions are unverified.
